name: 20-foot gaze break
instruction: Look at something about 20 feet away for 20 seconds
why: Gives your eyes a short screen break

name: Palming
instruction: Rest your palms lightly over closed eyes for 30 seconds, without pressing on them
why: Gives your eyes a short break from the screen

name: Near-far focus shift
instruction: Focus on something close by, then on something far away; repeat 3 times
why: Shifts focus between near and far distances
restrictions: not a substitute for care for dyslexia, eye spasms, or similar conditions

name: Shoulder rolls
instruction: Gently roll shoulders 3 times forward and 3 times back
why: Changes position and moves the shoulders

name: Chin tuck
instruction: Gently draw your chin straight back, keeping your eyes level; repeat 10 times
why: Moves the neck through a small range

name: Side neck stretch
instruction: Gently tilt your head toward one shoulder, then toward the other; 10 times per side
why: Moves the neck from side to side
restrictions: ease off if it worsens symptoms

name: Open/close hands
instruction: Gently make a fist, then open the hand and spread the fingers; repeat 3 times

name: Wrist side-to-side bend
instruction: With the forearm supported, gently bend the wrist side to side, 5-10 times in each direction
why: Moves the wrist through a side-to-side range

name: Hook fist to full fist
instruction: Bend the fingers into a hook fist, then close them into a full fist; repeat 10 times
why: Moves the fingers and hand through two grip positions

name: Slouch-to-tall
instruction: While seated, gently slouch, then sit tall; repeat 3 times
why: Changes the sitting position and gently moves the lower back
restrictions: omit for back pain/limits or uncertainty

name: Standing back extension
instruction: Stand with hands on your lower back and gently lean backward; repeat 3-5 times
why: Moves the lower back in the opposite direction to sitting

name: Cat stretch
instruction: On hands and knees, gently arch the back upward, then return to neutral; repeat 5 times
why: Moves the spine through a gentle curl

name: Stand and walk
instruction: Stand and walk near the desk for 60 seconds
why: Breaks up a long period of sitting

name: Wall press
instruction: Stand facing a wall with hands on it at shoulder height; bend the elbows to lean in, then press back. 3 sets of 10
why: Gets you standing and moving the arms and shoulders

name: Standing thigh stretch
instruction: Standing, bring one heel up toward your buttock and hold for 20 seconds; 3 times per leg
why: Moves the front of the thigh while standing

name: Posture self-check
instruction: Check: head and neck balanced, shoulders relaxed, wrists in line, lower back supported, and feet supported
why: Notices the current setup without a camera

name: Chin tuck (seated)
instruction: Seated, gently draw the chin straight back and hold for 5 seconds; repeat 3 times

name: Wall posture check
instruction: Stand with your back against a wall and check the contact at head, shoulders, and lower back
why: Checks standing posture against a flat surface
